items.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
items.summary: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.

items.title: Bitwise shuts down Dogecoin ETF less than a year after launch
items.summary: BWOW generated about $3 million in trading volume when it launched in November 2025, but has failed to come anywhere close ever since.

items.title: New Clarity Act text tweaks DeFi, credit union provisions, but road ahead for bill remains murky
items.summary: The Clarity Act needs 60 votes when the Senate returns from its recess next week.

items.title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance
items.summary: The EU securities regulator flagged tokenized equities, DeFi exploits and prediction markets as areas where growing crypto ties could pose risks to the broader financial system.
